units.notes: FAA pavement reference configuration with independent dual-wheel main struts and two dual nose struts. Main wheel centers, reference gross weight and contact pressure are retained together from FAARFIELD; individual struts share main load equally. The 95% main-gear allocation is a design assumption. Taxi weight is unknown. Nose contact pressure uses the main reference pressure as an explicit modeling assumption. USACE main-centroid wheelbase and nose pitch supplement the FAA main footprint. USACE uses a different weight/pressure case; those load values are not mixed into this entry. Nominal tires follow Antonov qualification-test sizes. Dedicated FlightGear airframe overlay is illustrative, not manufacturer CAD or a kneeling/steering simulation.
